find_email.description: Launch an Icypeas Email Finder search for one person using their name and their employer's domain or company name. This starts an asynchronous search and returns a search id. Use 'Get results' with that id to read the found email once the search has finished.
find_email.name: find_email

parameters.description: The person's employer, given as a domain (e.g. icypeas.com) or a company name (e.g. Icypeas)
parameters.name: domain_or_company

parameters.description: First name of the person. Required unless a last name is provided.
parameters.name: firstname

parameters.description: Last name of the person. Required unless a first name is provided.
parameters.name: lastname

parameters.description: Optional URL Icypeas will POST the result to when the search finishes
parameters.name: webhook_url

parameters.description: Optional tag echoed back on the result so you can correlate it with your own records
parameters.name: external_id

get_results.description: Read the results of a previously launched Icypeas search (email finder, email verifier, or domain scan) by its search id. Because searches run asynchronously, the result may still be pending; run this again if the search has not finished.
get_results.name: get_results

parameters.description: The search id returned by Find email, Verify email, or Scan domain
parameters.name: search_id

scan_domain.description: Launch an Icypeas Domain Scan to discover role-based email addresses at a company (for example contact@ or support@). This starts an asynchronous search and returns a search id. Use 'Get results' with that id to read the discovered addresses once the scan has finished.
scan_domain.name: scan_domain

parameters.description: The company to scan, given as a domain (e.g. icypeas.com) or a company name (e.g. Icypeas)
parameters.name: domain_or_company

parameters.description: Optional URL Icypeas will POST the result to when the scan finishes
parameters.name: webhook_url

parameters.description: Optional tag echoed back on the result so you can correlate it with your own records
parameters.name: external_id

verify_email.description: Launch an Icypeas Email Verifier search to check whether an email address is valid and deliverable. This starts an asynchronous search and returns a search id. Use 'Get results' with that id to read the verdict once the search has finished.
verify_email.name: verify_email

parameters.description: Optional URL Icypeas will POST the result to when the search finishes
parameters.name: webhook_url

parameters.description: Optional tag echoed back on the result so you can correlate it with your own records
parameters.name: external_id

description: Automate Icypeas: find professional email addresses, verify deliverability, and scan a company's domain for role-based addresses with an API key.
